definitions.meaning: Data headings use the laboratory frame unless marked -CM. Thus EN is lab energy; ANG-CM and DATA-CM identify center-of-mass quantities.
SIG denotes a cross section integrated over secondary angles/energies, with area units. Incident-energy integration is INT with area times energy units.
DA denotes d sigma / d Omega. The supplied values retain cross-section-per-solid-angle units.
EP selects electric multipolarity; POLAR=2 selects quadrupole. M0011003 is an E2 component, not a beam polarization degree of two.

nonimplications: These definitions do not supply experimental energy-response weights or an identical-dd full-sphere event-counting convention.
No unit/frame conversion, angular integration or summation of the E2 component with the total SIG is performed.
